en.t: Liu Bang is enthroned as emperor of the Han dynasty
en.s: On February 28, 202 BC, in the proleptic Julian calendar, Liu Bang was enthroned as emperor of the Han dynasty in present-day China. The Book of Han records the ceremony on the jiawu day of the second month in the fifth year counted from his rule as king of Han.
en.n: Converted historical date in the proleptic Julian calendar, not an original Western calendar date.

zh.t: 刘邦即皇帝位，建立汉朝
zh.s: 按追溯使用的儒略历换算，公元前202年2月28日，刘邦在今中国境内即皇帝位。《汉书》将日期记为汉王五年二月甲午，这里的年号从他出任汉王时算起。
zh.n: 此日期由中国古代历法换算为儒略历，并非原始记载直接使用的西历日期。

en.s: The Siege of Jaén (1245–1246) was the final siege of the city conducted by King Ferdinand of Castile during the Reconquista. In the episode of 1245–1246, Ferdinand and his ally, the Order of Santiago successfully captured the city after Muhammad I of Granada agreed to surrender the city in exchange for recognition as Granada's ruler.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 哈恩围城战（1245—1246年）是收复失地运动期间，卡斯蒂利亚国王费迪南德围攻该城的最后一战。1245—1246年的这次围城中，费迪南德及其盟友圣地亚哥骑士团成功攻占该城；格拉纳达统治者穆罕默德一世则同意投降，以换取对其统治地位的承认。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Cartagena took place on 28 February 1758 off the Spanish port of Cartagena during the Seven Years' War. A British fleet under Henry Osborn, which had blockaded a French fleet in Cartagena, attacked and defeated a French squadron under Michel-Ange Duquesne de Menneville coming to their assistance.

zh.s: 卡塔赫纳海战于1758年2月28日在七年战争期间、卡塔赫纳港外海展开。亨利·奥斯本率领的英国舰队封锁了卡塔赫纳的一支法国舰队，随后袭击并击败了前来支援、由米歇尔-安热·迪凯讷·德梅讷维尔率领的法国分舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Bishops Court, also known as The Defeat of Thurot, was a naval engagement that took place 28 February 1760, during the Seven Years' War, between three British ships and three French ships. The French force under famed commander François Thurot were brought to battle in the Irish sea between the Isle of Man and the coast of Ireland at 9 am. After a close-fought action, Thurot's force was battered into submission, with his ships dismasted and reduced to a sinking condition. Thurot was shot through the heart and died during the action. The British took all three French ships, completing victory.

zh.s: 1760年2月28日，七年战争期间，三艘英国军舰与三艘法国军舰交战，史称主教庄园海战，也称蒂罗战败之役。上午9点，著名指挥官弗朗索瓦·蒂罗率领的法国舰队，在马恩岛与爱尔兰海岸之间的爱尔兰海被迫迎战。激战后，法舰桅杆被打断，损坏严重，濒临沉没，最终投降。蒂罗在战斗中心脏中弹身亡，英军俘获全部三艘法舰，取得完全胜利。

en.s: On the Day of Daggers (French: Journée des Poignards), 28 February 1791, hundreds of nobles with concealed weapons such as daggers went to the Tuileries Palace, in Paris, to defend King Louis XVI while Marquis de Lafayette led the National Guard in Vincennes to stop a riot. A confrontation between the guards and the nobles started, as the guards thought that the nobles had come to take the King away.

zh.s: 1791年2月28日“匕首日”（法语：Journée des Poignards），数百名贵族携带匕首等隐藏武器前往巴黎杜伊勒里宫保护路易十六。当时拉斐特侯爵正率领国民自卫军前往万塞讷镇压骚乱。卫兵与贵族发生冲突，因为卫兵以为贵族要带走国王。

en.s: The action of 28 February 1799 was a minor naval engagement of the East Indies theatre of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought off the mouth of the Hooghly River in the Bay of Bengal between the French frigate Forte and the Royal Navy frigate HMS Sybille. Forte was an exceptionally large and powerful ship engaged on a commerce raiding operation against British merchant shipping off the port of Calcutta in British India.

zh.s: 1799年2月28日海战是法国大革命战争东印度战区的一场小规模海战，发生在孟加拉湾胡格利河口外海，交战双方为法国护卫舰“福尔特”号和英国皇家海军护卫舰“西比尔”号。“福尔特”号是一艘异常庞大而强劲的舰船，当时正在英属印度加尔各答港外海执行袭击商船的任务。

en.s: The Battle of Cúcuta was a military conflict in the Spanish American wars of independence fought on February 28, 1813 between the pro-independence forces led by Simón Bolívar and Spanish royalist troops under General Ramón Correa at the town of Cúcuta, in present-day Colombia, close to the border with Venezuela. Bolivar was victorious. The battle gained him much support and immediately preceded his march into Venezuela, later dubbed the Admirable Campaign.

zh.s: 1813年2月28日，西属美洲独立战争期间，西蒙·玻利瓦尔率独立派部队，与拉蒙·科雷亚将军指挥的西班牙保王军，在今哥伦比亚靠近委内瑞拉边境的库库塔镇交战。玻利瓦尔获胜，赢得大量支持，随即向委内瑞拉进军，展开后来被称为“光荣战役”的行动。

en.s: The Battle of San Mateo was a series of battles in the Valleys of Aragua in what is now Venezuela, during the Venezuelan War of Independence between 28 February and 25 March 1814.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 圣马特奥之战是委内瑞拉独立战争期间在阿拉瓜山谷发生的一系列战斗，时间为1814年2月28日至3月25日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Battle of Makwanpur was fought on 28 February 1816 in Makwanpurgadhi, Nepal between Nepal and the East India Company. It resulted in British victory.

zh.s: 1816年2月28日，尼泊尔与英国东印度公司在尼泊尔马克万普尔加迪交战。英方获胜。

en.t: A gun explodes on board the steam warship USS Princeton during a pleasure cruise down the Potomac River, killing six, including Secretary of State Abel Upshur. President John Tyler, who is also on board, is not injured from the blast
en.s: USS Princeton was a screw steam warship of the United States Navy. Commanded by Captain Robert F. Stockton, Princeton was launched on 5 September 1843. On 28 February 1844, during a Potomac River pleasure cruise for dignitaries, one gun exploded, killing six people, including Secretary of State Abel P. Upshur and Secretary of the Navy Thomas Walker Gilmer, and injuring others, including a United States Senator and Captain Stockton.

zh.t: 普林斯顿号蒸汽军舰发生舰炮爆炸
zh.s: 美国海军螺旋桨蒸汽军舰“普林斯顿”号在波托马克河上进行招待贵宾的游船活动时，一门舰炮发生爆炸，造成六人死亡。遇难者包括国务卿阿贝尔·P·厄普舍和海军部长托马斯·沃克·吉尔默。其他人受伤，其中包括一名联邦参议员和舰长罗伯特·F·斯托克顿。事件发生于1844年2月28日。

en.s: The Battle of Sacramento, or the battle of the Sacramento River, took place on February 28, 1847, during the Mexican–American War. About fifteen miles (24 km) north of Chihuahua, Mexico, at the crossing of the Sacramento River, American forces numbering less than 1,000 defeated the superior Mexican army.

zh.t: 墨西哥萨克拉门托战役
zh.s: 1847年2月28日，美墨战争期间，双方在墨西哥奇瓦瓦市以北约15英里、即24公里的萨克拉门托河渡口交战。不足1000人的美军击败了人数占优的墨西哥军，史称萨克拉门托战役或萨克拉门托河战役。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in France on 28 February 1857, with a second round on 5 March. According to the constitution of the empire, partisans of the regime ran as "official candidates" of the regime in often gerrymandered circonscriptions. As official candidates, their campaign expenditures were paid by the government and their campaigns led by the local government.

zh.s: 原文记载，法国于1857年2月28日举行议会选举，3月5日举行第二轮。依据帝国宪法，政权支持者以“官方候选人”身份，在经常被人为划分以利于当权者的选区参选。他们的竞选费用由政府支付，竞选活动也由地方政府主导。

en.s: The Battle of Island Number Ten was an engagement at the New Madrid or Kentucky Bend on the Mississippi River – forming the border between Missouri and Tennessee – during the American Civil War, lasting from February 28 to April 8, 1862. Island Number Ten, a small island at the (Tennessee) base of a tight double turn in the river, was held by the Confederates from the early days of the war.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 十号岛之战是美国内战期间发生在新马德里弯道（又称肯塔基弯道）的战斗。战场位于密西西比河上，河流构成密苏里州与田纳西州的边界；战斗从1862年2月28日持续至4月8日。十号岛是一座小岛，位于河道紧密的双重弯曲处田纳西一侧的底部；战争初期，南方邦联军便控制了该岛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The February 1880 Victorian colonial election was held on 28 February 1880 to elect the 10th Parliament of Victoria. All 86 seats in 55 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though two seats were uncontested. There were 31 single-member, 20 two-member and 5 three-member electorates. The liberal (or protectionist) government of Graham Berry was narrowly defeated by the Constitutionalist (moderate liberal) opposition led by James Service, who formed a new government on March 5.

zh.s: 1880年2月28日，维多利亚殖民地举行选举，选出第十届议会。立法议会55个选区共86个席位全部改选，其中两个席位没有竞争者。选区包括31个单议席、20个双议席和5个三议席选区。格雷厄姆·贝里领导的自由派（或贸易保护派）政府以微弱差距败给詹姆斯·服务领导的宪政派（温和自由派）反对党。服务于3月5日组建新政府。

en.s: The 1885 Scottish Cup final was the 12th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1884–85 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. For only the second time in the competition's history, the final was contested by two teams from outside Glasgow: Renton, who had never won the cup before, and three-time winners Vale of Leven, representing neighbouring communities in Dunbartonshire (their home grounds were approximately 1.6 miles (2.6 km) apart).
en.n: This entry records the replay date, as explicitly given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1885年苏格兰杯决赛是第12届苏格兰杯决赛，也是1884—85赛季苏格兰杯的决赛；该赛事是苏格兰最重要的淘汰赛足球赛事。历史上第二次，决赛由两支格拉斯哥以外的球队交锋：从未夺冠的伦顿队和曾三次夺冠的莱文谷队。两队分别代表邓巴顿郡相邻的社区，主场相距约1.6英里（2.6公里）。

en.s: The 1891 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 4th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1891 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Clonturk Park, Dublin, on 28 February 1892, between Kerry and Wexford. The Leinster champions lost out to their Munster counterparts on a score line of 2–3 to 1–5.

zh.t: 1891年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1891年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛，于1892年2月28日在都柏林克朗特克公园举行，是第四届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该项爱尔兰顶尖郡队之间赛事的收官战。芒斯特冠军凯里以2个进球加3分，击败伦斯特冠军韦克斯福德的1个进球加5分。

en.t: The delayed 1891 All-Ireland football final is played
en.s: On February 28, 1892, the final of the 1891 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship was played at Clonturk Park in Dublin, in present-day Ireland. A snowstorm had forced the Gaelic football final to be postponed from February 21.

zh.t: 延期举行的1891年全爱尔兰盖尔式足球决赛开赛
zh.s: 1892年2月28日，1891年全爱尔兰高级组盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛在今爱尔兰都柏林克朗特克公园举行。比赛原定于2月21日进行，因暴风雪延期。

en.t: USS Indiana is launched at Philadelphia
en.s: On February 28, 1893, the battleship USS Indiana was launched at William Cramp & Sons’ shipyard in Philadelphia, United States. Its commissioning into naval service followed in 1895.

zh.t: “印第安纳”号战列舰在费城下水
zh.s: 1893年2月28日，美国“印第安纳”号战列舰在费城威廉·克兰普父子造船厂下水。该舰直到1895年才正式服役。

en.s: Early parliamentary elections were held in the Kingdom of Croatia-Slavonia on 27 and 28 February 1908, after being called by Ban Pavao Rauch.

en.t: Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes
en.s: The Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes or Winter Battle of the Masurian Lakes, known in Germany as the Winter Battle in Masuria and in Russia as the Battle of Augustowo, was the northern part of the Central Powers' offensive on the Eastern Front in the winter of 1915 during World War I. The offensive was intended to advance beyond the Vistula River and potentially knock Russia out of the war.

zh.s: 第二次马祖里湖战役又称冬季马祖里湖战役，在德国被称为马祖里冬季战役，在俄罗斯则称奥古斯图夫战役。它是第一次世界大战期间1915年冬季同盟国东线攻势的北部战场。攻势意在越过维斯瓦河，并可能迫使俄罗斯退出战争。

en.s: The Unilateral Declaration of Egyptian Independence on 28 February 1922 was the formal legal instrument by which the United Kingdom recognised Egypt as an independent sovereign state. According to the official British archives, Egypt became an independent state after the issuance of the declaration of February 28, 1922, by which Egypt became an independent state, thus ending exactly 40 years of British occupation of Egypt.

zh.s: 1922年2月28日发表的埃及单方面独立宣言，是英国承认埃及为独立主权国家的正式法律文件。根据英国官方档案，宣言发布后埃及成为独立国家，也结束了英国对埃及长达整整40年的占领。

en.t: The Charlevoix-Kamouraska earthquake strikes northeastern North America
en.s: The 1925 Charlevoix–Kamouraska earthquake struck northeastern North America on February 28, reaching 6.2 on the moment magnitude scale. It was one of the most powerful measured in Canada in the 20th century, with a maximum perceived intensity of VIII (Severe) on the Mercalli intensity scale at its epicentre in the area of Charlevoix-Kamouraska along the Saint Lawrence River near île aux Lièvres and not greater than VI (Strong) in the United States.

zh.t: 夏勒瓦-卡穆拉斯卡地震
zh.s: 1925年2月28日，夏勒瓦-卡穆拉斯卡地震袭击北美东北部，矩震级达到6.2级。这是20世纪加拿大有测量记录的最强地震之一。圣劳伦斯河沿岸、利耶夫尔岛附近的夏勒瓦-卡穆拉斯卡地区震中麦加利烈度最高达VIII度（严重）；美国境内的烈度不超过VI度（强）。

zh.s: 埃尔布拉马德罗战役，也称布罗马德罗斯战役，于1928年2月27日至28日发生，属于美国1926—1933年占领尼加拉瓜期间的桑地诺反抗活动。战斗始于27日，一支运输队由36名海军陆战队员、1名美国海军药剂士、20名尼加拉瓜赶骡人、2名赶骡人领班及99头骡子组成，由爱德华·F.中尉率领。原文在指挥官姓名处中断。

en.s: The Vyazma Airborne Operation was a Red Army airborne landing in the rear of German lines during the Battles of Rzhev. It took place from 18 January to 28 February 1942. The objective of the airborne landing was to help troops of the Kalinin Front and Western Front to encircle and destroy Army Group Centre. The airborne operation was unsuccessful and resulted in the loss of most of the troops landed.

en.s: The Demyansk Offensive Operation was part of the Soviet strategic offensive known as Operation Polar Star against Axis forces. The operation took place in Demyansk from 15 to 28 February 1943. The Northwestern Front and Mikhail Khozin Special Group engaged the 16th Army of Army Group North in an operation for control of Demyansk and to destroy Axis forces in the region.

en.s: This is a sub-article to Battle of Narva (1944). The Narva offensive (15–28 February 1944) was a campaign fought between the German army detachment "Narwa" and the Soviet Leningrad Front for the strategically important Narva Isthmus. At the time of the operation, Stalin was personally interested in taking Estonia, viewing it as a precondition for forcing Finland out of the war.

en.s: The 1957 Wednesbury by-election was held on 28 February 1957 after the incumbent Labour MP, Stanley Evans, resigned from Parliament and the Labour Party after he had refused to vote against the government on the Suez Crisis. The Labour candidate, John Stonehouse, retained the seat with an increased majority.

zh.s: 1957年2月28日，英国温斯伯里选区举行补选。原任工党议员斯坦利·埃文斯拒绝在苏伊士运河危机问题上投票反对政府，随后辞去议员职务并退出工党。工党候选人约翰·斯通豪斯当选，以更大的领先优势保住议席。

en.t: Megan Lloyd George wins the Carmarthen by-election
en.s: On February 28, 1957, Megan Lloyd George won the parliamentary by-election in Carmarthen, Wales, United Kingdom, for Labour. The constituency changed hands from the Liberal Party.

zh.t: 梅甘·劳合·乔治赢得卡马森补选
zh.s: 1957年2月28日，梅甘·劳合·乔治代表工党赢得英国威尔士卡马森议会席位补选，该选区由自由党转为工党掌握。

en.t: Kerala votes as part of India’s general election
en.s: On February 28, 1957, voting took place in Kerala as part of India’s general election. The state elected 18 Lok Sabha members in the election overall.

zh.t: 喀拉拉邦在印度大选中投票
zh.s: 1957年2月28日，印度喀拉拉邦在全国大选中进行投票。该邦在这次选举中总共选出18名人民院议员。

en.s: The Prestonsburg, Kentucky, bus crash occurred on February 28, 1958, on U.S. Route 23 in Floyd County, Kentucky, when a school bus carrying 48 elementary and high school students struck the rear of a wrecker truck, causing the bus to plunge into the icy waters of the rain-swollen Levisa Fork of the Big Sandy River.

zh.t: 肯塔基州普雷斯顿斯堡校车事故
zh.s: 1958年2月28日，美国肯塔基州弗洛伊德县23号公路发生普雷斯顿斯堡校车事故。一辆载有48名中小学生的校车撞上清障车尾部，随后坠入大桑迪河勒维萨支流。河水因降雨上涨，冰冷刺骨。

en.t: Discoverer 1, an American spy satellite that is the first object intended to achieve a polar orbit, is launched but fails to achieve orbit
en.s: Discoverer 1 was the first of a series of satellites which were part of the CORONA reconnaissance satellite program. It was launched on a Thor-Agena A rocket on 28 February 1959 at 21:49:16 GMT from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. It was a prototype of the KH-1 satellite, but did not contain either a camera or a film capsule.

zh.s: 发现者1号是美国CORONA侦察卫星计划中的首颗卫星，也是该系列中的第一颗卫星。它于1959年2月28日21:49:16（格林尼治标准时间）从加利福尼亚州范登堡空军基地发射，使用雷神-阿金纳A型火箭，但未能进入轨道。它是KH-1卫星的原型，没有配备相机或胶片舱。

en.s: On February 28, 1966, a Northrop T-38 Talon from NASA crashed at Lambert Field in St. Louis, Missouri, United States, killing two Project Gemini astronauts, Elliot See and Charles Bassett. The aircraft, piloted by See, crashed into the McDonnell Aircraft building where their Gemini 9 spacecraft was being assembled. The weather was poor with rain, snow, fog, and low clouds.

zh.s: 1966年2月28日，一架NASA的诺斯罗普T-38“禽爪”式教练机在美国密苏里州圣路易斯的兰伯特机场坠毁，双子星计划的两名宇航员埃利奥特·西和查尔斯·巴塞特遇难。由西驾驶的飞机撞上麦克唐纳飞机公司大楼，当时他们的双子星9号飞船正在那里组装。事发时天气恶劣，有雨、雪、雾和低云。

en.s: The Mizo National Front uprising (Mizo: Rambuai) was a revolt against the government of India aimed at establishing a sovereign nation state for the Mizo people, which started on 28 February 1966. On 1 March 1966, the Mizo National Front (MNF) made a declaration of independence, after launching coordinated attacks on the Government offices and security forces post in different parts of the Mizo district in Assam.

zh.s: 米佐民族阵线起义（米佐语：Rambuai）是反抗印度政府的武装起义，目标是为米佐人建立主权国家，始于1966年2月28日。1966年3月1日，米佐民族阵线发动协调行动，袭击阿萨姆邦米佐地区多处政府机关和安全部队哨所，随后宣布独立。

en.s: The Battle of Prek Klok I occurred on February 28, 1967 during Operation Junction City, a search and destroy mission by American military forces in Tay Ninh Province of South Vietnam, to the west of the capital Saigon. A few days before the battle, the 1st Battalion, 16th Infantry of the United States was brought into the area near Suoi Da and Prek Klok to defend a highway, airfield, and artillery base in the area, and to carry out search and destroy operations around it. On the morning of February, elements of the battalion headed east, and were attacked from the front by Viet Cong infantry with gunfire, rockets and mortars.

zh.t: 第一次普雷克克洛克战斗
zh.s: 第一次普雷克克洛克战斗于1967年2月28日发生。当时美军正在南越首都西贡以西的西宁省，执行“交汇点城行动”搜剿任务。几天前，美军第16步兵团第一营被调到苏艾达和普雷克克洛克附近，保卫当地公路、机场及炮兵基地，并在周边搜剿。2月某天上午，该营部分部队向东行进，遭越共步兵从正面以枪炮、火箭和迫击炮攻击。原文在这句中未写明具体日期。

en.t: South Africa’s parliament elects Dönges state president
en.s: On February 28, 1967, South Africa’s parliament elected Theophilus Ebenhaezer Dönges as state president. This was a parliamentary election for the then largely ceremonial office, not a direct public presidential vote.

zh.t: 南非议会选举登格斯为国家总统
zh.s: 1967年2月28日，南非议会选举特奥菲勒斯·埃本哈泽·登格斯为国家总统。该职位当时主要承担礼仪职能，此次由议会选举产生，并非全民直选。

en.s: The 1969 Portugal earthquake struck western Portugal and Morocco on 28 February at 02:40 UTC. Originating west of the Strait of Gibraltar, the earthquake registered a magnitude of 7.8 and the maximum felt intensity was VII (Very strong) on the Mercalli intensity scale. In total, 13 people died and 80 sustained minor injuries. It was the largest earthquake to hit Portugal since the 1755 Lisbon earthquake.
en.n: The 1969 Portugal earthquake hits Portugal, Spain and Morocco.

zh.s: 1969年2月28日02:40（UTC），葡萄牙西部和摩洛哥发生地震，震级为7.8级。震中位于直布罗陀海峡以西，麦加利烈度最高为VII度（很强）。地震共造成13人死亡、80人轻伤，是1755年里斯本大地震以来袭击葡萄牙的最大地震。
zh.n: 1969年葡萄牙地震袭击了葡萄牙、西班牙和摩洛哥。

en.t: Japanese police stormed a mountain lodge near Karuizawa, Nagano Prefecture, to end a ten-day siege by members of the paramilitary group United Red Army
en.s: The Asama-Sansō incident (あさま山荘事件, Asama sansō jiken) was a hostage crisis and police standoff at a mountain lodge near Karuizawa in Nagano Prefecture, Japan, which lasted from February 19 to February 28, 1972. The police rescue operation on the final day of the standoff was the first marathon live television broadcast in Japan, lasting 10 hours and 40 minutes.

zh.s: 浅间山庄事件（日语：あさま山荘事件）是一起人质危机和警方对峙事件，地点在日本长野县轻井泽附近的一处山庄，时间为1972年2月19日至28日。警方在对峙最后一天展开营救行动，这是日本首次持续10小时40分钟的马拉松式电视直播。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1973 was held on 28 February 1973. The newly elected 144 members of the 20th Dáil assembled at Leinster House on 4 March when the new Taoiseach and government were appointed. The general election took place in 42 parliamentary constituencies throughout Ireland for 144 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann.

en.t: Aeroflot Flight X-167 crashes during takeoff from Semey Airport, killing 32 people
en.s: Flight X-167 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated by Aeroflot from Semipalatinsk (now Semey) to Karaganda on February 28, 1973. The flight, conducted with a Yakovlev Yak-40 aircraft, ended in tragedy when the plane crashed shortly after takeoff, resulting in the deaths of all 32 occupants on board. The exact cause of the accident remains undetermined despite extensive investigation.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空X-167号航班坠毁
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空X-167号航班原为从塞米巴拉金斯克（今塞梅）飞往卡拉干达的定期国内客运航班。1973年2月28日，航班使用雅克-40飞机，在起飞后不久坠毁，机上32人全部遇难。经过广泛调查，事故确切原因仍未确定。

en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on Thursday 28 February 1974. The Labour Party, led by former Prime Minister Harold Wilson, gained seats, and became the largest party, but was short of an overall majority. The governing Conservative Party, led by Prime Minister Edward Heath, lost seats, even though it polled a higher vote share than Labour. This resulted in the first hung parliament since 1929.

zh.s: 英国于1974年2月28日星期四举行大选。前首相哈罗德·威尔逊领导的工党增加议席，成为第一大党，但未取得过半数。首相爱德华·希思领导的执政保守党，虽得票率高于工党，却失去部分议席，形成1929年以来首次没有任何政党过半数的议会。

en.t: February 1974 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 28 February 1974, the February 1974 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 635 members of the House of Commons, including the 12 Northern Ireland seats. The election took place soon after the Sunningdale Agreement, signed 9 December 1973. On 1 January 1974, an Executive was formed under the terms of the Agreement, based on the result of the 1973 Northern Ireland Assembly election, with Ulster Unionist Party leader Brian Faulkner as Chief Executive.

zh.s: 1974年2月28日，英国举行大选，选出下议院全部635名议员，其中北爱尔兰占12席。此次选举在1973年12月9日签署《桑宁代尔协议》后不久举行。依照协议及1973年北爱尔兰议会选举结果，北爱尔兰已于1974年1月1日成立行政机构，由阿尔斯特统一党领袖布赖恩·福克纳担任行政首脑。

en.t: February 1974 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 28 February 1974, the February 1974 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 635 members of the House of Commons, with 516 constituencies being in England. It was the first of two general elections held that year. While in the House of Commons, there emerged a hung parliament with the Labour Party winning 301 seats to the 297 won by the Conservative Party, in England, the Conservatives won 268 seats to Labour's 237.

en.s: The Moorgate tube crash occurred on 28 February 1975 at 8:46 am on the London Underground's Northern City Line; 43 people died and 74 were injured after a train failed to stop at the line's southern terminus, Moorgate station, and crashed into its end wall. It is considered the worst peacetime accident on the London Underground.

zh.s: 1975年2月28日上午8时46分，伦敦地铁北城线发生穆尔盖特地铁事故。一列列车未能在南端终点站穆尔盖特站停下，撞上线路尽头的墙壁，造成43人死亡、74人受伤。这被认为是伦敦地铁最严重的和平时期事故。

en.s: The Nelson by-election was a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Nelson a predominantly urban seat at the top of the South Island. The by-election occurred on 28 February 1976, and was precipitated by the death of sitting Labour Party MP and Speaker of the House Sir Stanley Whitehead on 9 January 1976. The by-election was contested by all major parties. It was won by Mel Courtney, the Labour Party candidate, with a majority of 1505 (Courtney increased the majority Whitehead had achieved in the 1975 general election by an impressive 50 per cent-only three months after the National Party's landslide victory).

zh.s: 1976年2月28日，新西兰南岛北端、以城市为主的尼尔森选区举行补选。原任工党议员兼众议院议长斯坦利·怀特黑德爵士于1月9日去世，导致议席空缺。各主要政党均参选，工党候选人梅尔·考特尼以1505票优势获胜。距离国家党压倒性赢得全国大选仅三个月，他便把怀特黑德在1975年大选取得的领先票数提高了50%。

en.s: The 1976 Football League Cup final took place between Manchester City and Newcastle United on 28 February 1976 at Wembley Stadium. It was the sixteenth final and the tenth Football League Cup final to be played at Wembley. Manchester City won the match 2–1 to win the competition for the second time. The match is best known for its winning goal, an overhead kick by Dennis Tueart.

zh.s: 1976年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于1976年2月28日在温布利球场举行，由曼彻斯特城对阵纽卡斯尔联。这是第16场联赛杯决赛，也是第10次在温布利举行。曼彻斯特城以2比1获胜，第二次夺得赛事冠军。比赛最为人熟知的是丹尼斯·图尔特踢进的制胜倒钩球。

en.s: On 28 February 1985, the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) launched a heavy mortar attack on the Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) base at Corry Square in Newry, Northern Ireland. The attack killed nine RUC officers and injured almost 40 others; the highest death toll ever suffered by the RUC. Afterwards, a major building scheme was begun, to give police and military bases better protection from such attacks.

en.s: Olof Palme, Prime Minister of Sweden, was assassinated on 28 February 1986 in Stockholm, Sweden, at 23:21 hours Central European Time (22:21 UTC). Palme was fatally wounded by a single gunshot while walking home from a cinema with his wife Lisbet Palme on the central Stockholm street Sveavägen. Mrs Palme was slightly wounded by a second shot. The couple did not have bodyguards at the time. Christer Pettersson, a substance abuser who previously had been convicted of manslaughter, was convicted of the murder in 1988 after having been identified as the killer by Palme's wife.

zh.s: 1986年2月28日欧洲中部时间23时21分，即协调世界时22时21分，瑞典首相奥洛夫·帕尔梅在斯德哥尔摩遇刺。他与妻子莉斯贝特看完电影，步行经过市中心斯韦亚大道回家时，被一枪击中并致命，妻子被第二枪轻伤。两人当时没有保镖随行。帕尔梅夫人指认克里斯特·佩特松为凶手后，他于1988年被判谋杀罪成立。佩特松有药物滥用问题，此前曾因过失杀人被定罪。

en.s: STS-36 was a NASA Space Shuttle mission, during which Space Shuttle Atlantis carried a classified payload for the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) (believed to have been a Misty reconnaissance satellite) into orbit. STS-36 was the 34th shuttle mission overall, the sixth flight for Atlantis, and the fourth night launch of the shuttle program. It launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on February 28, 1990, and landed on March 4, 1990.

zh.t: 土耳其军方备忘录导致联合政府垮台
zh.s: 1997年土耳其军事备忘录（土耳其语：28 Şubat，意为“2月28日”；也称“后现代政变”）指土耳其军方领导层在1997年2月28日国家安全委员会会议上发布的一系列决定。这些决定导致福利党籍伊斯兰主义总理内克梅丁·埃尔巴坎辞职，其联合政府也随之结束。

zh.s: 北好莱坞枪战又称北好莱坞之战，发生于1997年2月28日。两名全副武装并穿着防弹装备的银行劫匪拉里·菲利普斯二世和埃米尔·马塔萨雷努，在洛杉矶北好莱坞街区与警方交火。两名劫匪均在枪战中死亡，12名警员和8名平民受伤。劫匪和警方共发射近2,000发子弹，导致多辆车辆及其他财物受损或被毁。

en.s: The Eastleigh by-election, 2013 was a parliamentary by-election held on 28 February 2013 for the United Kingdom House of Commons constituency of Eastleigh in Hampshire. The election was triggered by the resignation of the sitting MP, Liberal Democrat Chris Huhne, which took effect on 5 February 2013. The resignation coincided with his guilty plea on the eve of a court case in which he and his ex-wife were to be prosecuted for lying to police about a historical speeding offence (committed in 2003 but which only came to light in May 2011).

zh.s: 2013年2月28日，英国汉普郡伊斯特利选区举行下议院补选。自由民主党议员克里斯·休恩辞职，辞职于2月5日生效。当天恰逢他在案件开审前认罪：他与前妻因就2003年一宗超速事件向警方撒谎而被起诉，此事直到2011年5月才曝光。

en.s: The 2015 President's Cup was the second President's Cup contested for. The match was played between 2014 League of Ireland champions Dundalk and 2014 FAI Cup winners, St Patrick's Athletic on 28 February 2015, at Oriel Park. Dundalk came from behind to win the game 2-1. Christopher Forrester put St Patrick's Athletic ahead in the 35th minute when he turned in a low cross from the right from close range.

zh.s: 2015年总统杯是该项赛事的第二届。比赛于2015年2月28日在奥里尔公园举行，由2014年爱尔兰超级联赛冠军邓多克队对阵2014年爱尔兰足协杯冠军圣帕特里克竞技队。邓多克在先失一球后以2比1逆转获胜。克里斯托弗·福雷斯特在第35分钟接右路低平传中，近距离破门，为圣帕特里克竞技队取得领先。

en.s: The 2016 New Territories East by-election was held on 28 February 2016 after the incumbent Legislative Councillor Ronny Tong Ka-wah of New Territories East quit the Civic Party and resigned from the Legislative Council of Hong Kong (LegCo), effective on 1 October 2015. The winning candidate in the by-election serves a term of only around five months, as the session of legislature ends in July 2016. Though the term is short, the pan-democrats saw the seat as crucial, fearing that the pro-Beijing camp would modify the rules of procedure if they gained a majority of the geographical constituency seats to block pan-democrats' filibustering, as the seats in the geographical constituencies commanded by two camps were evenly 17-17 before the election.

zh.s: 2016年2月28日，香港新界东举行立法会补选。原任议员汤家骅退出公民党并辞去议席，辞职于2015年10月1日生效。由于当届立法会会期在2016年7月结束，胜选者任期仅约五个月。尽管任期短，泛民主派仍认为该席位至关重要：补选前，两大阵营在地区直选各占17席，泛民主派担心建制派一旦取得地区直选多数，就会修改议事规则，阻止泛民主派以冗长发言拖延议程。

en.s: The 2016 Football League Cup final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium, London, on 28 February 2016 to determine the winner of the 2015–16 Football League Cup, the 56th edition of the Football League Cup, a competition for the 92 teams in the Premier League and Football League. It was contested by Liverpool and Manchester City, with Manchester City winning 3–1 in a penalty shoot-out after the match had finished 1–1 after extra time.

zh.s: 2015—16赛季英格兰联赛杯决赛，于2016年2月28日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由利物浦对阵曼城。这是第56届联赛杯的最后一场比赛，该项赛事由英超及英格兰足球联赛的92支球队参加。双方加时赛后1比1战平，曼城在点球大战中以3比1获胜。

en.s: The 2019 Dhaka North City Corporation by-election was held on 28 February 2019 due to the death of Mayor Annisul Huq. The election was boycotted by the main opposition, the BNP. zh.s: 达卡北市因市长安尼苏尔·胡克去世，于2019年2月28日举行补选。主要反对党孟加拉国民族主义党抵制投票，共五名市长候选人参选，阿提库尔·伊斯兰以786473票获胜。此次投票率较低，原文记载比上届下降6.24%。

en.s: The 2020–21 Scottish League Cup final was an association football match that took place at Hampden Park, Glasgow on 28 February 2021. It was the final match of the 2020–21 Scottish League Cup, the 75th season of the Scottish League Cup (known as the Betfred Cup for sponsorship reasons), a competition for the 42 teams in the Scottish Professional Football League (SPFL).

en.s: The 2023 Chicago elections took place in two rounds on February 28, 2023, and April 4, 2023. en.s: The 2023 Chicago aldermanic election took place in two rounds on February 28 and April 4, 2023, to elect 50 alderpersons to the Chicago City Council. Each alderperson represents one of Chicago's 50 wards. The elections are non-partisan and use a two-round system where the top two finishers compete in a second-round runoff if no candidate receives more than 50% of the vote in the first round.

en.s: On February 28, 2024, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin attacked the Malian military camp in Kwala, a village near Mourdiah, Mali. The attack was the first suicide car bombing by the group since 2022, and was part of a campaign by JNIM to expand influence in Koulikoro Region. Over thirty Malian soldiers were killed in the attack.

zh.s: 2024年2月28日，“支持伊斯兰与穆斯林”组织袭击马里穆尔迪亚附近夸拉村的军营，造成30多名马里士兵死亡。这是该组织自2022年以来首次发动自杀式汽车炸弹袭击，属于其扩大在库利科罗地区影响力的行动。

en.s: The 2024 UEFA Women's Nations League final was a football match that determined the winners of the final tournament of the 2023–24 UEFA Women's Nations League. zh.s: 2024年2月28日，法国与西班牙在西班牙塞维利亚的拉卡尔图哈体育场，进行2023—24赛季欧洲女子国家联赛决赛，决定决赛阶段的冠军。这是这项由欧洲足联各成员协会女子国家队参加的国际足球赛事的首届决赛。

en.t: Modi lays the foundation stone for India’s second spaceport
en.s: On February 28, 2024, Indian prime minister Narendra Modi remotely laid the foundation stone for the new spaceport at Kulasekarapattinam in Tamil Nadu, India. It was the start of construction, rather than the opening of a fully operational spaceport.

zh.t: 莫迪为印度第二座航天发射场奠基
zh.s: 2024年2月28日，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪以远程方式，为泰米尔纳德邦库拉塞卡拉帕蒂南的新航天发射场奠基。这是建设项目的奠基，并非全面投入运行的发射场揭幕。

en.t: São Luiz wins the Recopa Gaúcha
en.s: On February 28, 2024, São Luiz defeated Grêmio 2–0 in the Recopa Gaúcha at Estádio 19 de Outubro in Ijuí, Brazil.

zh.t: 圣路易斯赢得高乔超级杯
zh.s: 2024年2月28日，圣路易斯在巴西伊茹伊的十月十九日体育场以2比0击败格雷米奥，赢得高乔超级杯。

en.t: An attack on Druze civilians prompts a security operation in Jaramana
en.s: On February 28, 2025, unidentified gunmen fired on a vehicle carrying Druze civilians in Jaramana, Syria, injuring two elderly people. Syrian security forces began an operation in the area.

zh.t: 杰拉马纳德鲁兹平民遇袭后，叙利亚安全部队展开行动
zh.s: 2025年2月28日，不明身份的枪手在叙利亚杰拉马纳向一辆载有德鲁兹平民的车辆开枪，造成两名老人受伤。叙利亚安全部队随后在当地展开行动。

en.s: On 28 February 2026, Ali Khamenei, the supreme leader of Iran, was assassinated in Tehran as part of a series of Israeli airstrikes aimed at high-ranking Iranian officials. Khamenei's death was confirmed by the Iranian government on 1 March. His death occurred as part of a wider joint operation by Israel and the United States using strategic locations intelligence from the US's Central Intelligence Agency to determine the whereabouts of several leaders.

zh.s: 原文记载，2026年2月28日，伊朗最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊在德黑兰遇刺，当时以色列正对伊朗高级官员发动一系列空袭，伊朗政府于3月1日确认其死亡。原文称，此事属于以色列与美国更大范围的联合行动，美国中央情报局提供战略地点情报，协助确定多名领导人的行踪。
